header.generator: plan/mk_placements.py (re-run after each building/prop is built; status flips planned->built automatically when the GLB exists)
header.coordinates: three.js world, meters, Y up. +x = east, +z = south, -z = north (Briarwood road), town square centre at (0,0,0). pos = piece origin (GLB origin is base-centre of footprint at ground level). rotY = radians about +Y, applied as object.rotation.y. Unrotated GLBs face SOUTH (+z): their front door / main facade is on +z.
header.piece: GLB path relative to the sanctuary-assets repo root (load via uT(path,bust)). Shared materials: models/town/martsirt/materials/manifest.json. Shrine excluded (statue not chosen).
header.status: 'built' = GLB exists now (bytes given); 'planned' = placeholder, path reserved, engine should draw a grey box of `footprint` (buildings) or skip (props).

node_conventions.col_*: Invisible box colliders (static). Use mesh bounds as AABB/OBB; never render.
node_conventions.npc_spot_<role>: Empty; NPC stand/sit/work spot. Its -Z(glTF)/forward axis is facing; e.g. npc_spot_innkeeper, npc_spot_smith.
node_conventions.nav_entry_outside / nav_entry_inside / n: Empties either side of the main door for pathfinding enter/exit; other nav_* (nav_cellar_down, nav_upper_corridor) are interior waypoints.
node_conventions.fx_<type>_*: Empty marking an FX emitter: fx_fire, fx_embers, fx_smoke_chimney, fx_steam, fx_drip, fx_glow_window, fx_candle, fx_dust. Spawn particle system / point light at node transform; nothing in GLB lights.
node_conventions.sway_*: Rigid hanging object (lantern, sign iron) pivoting at node origin; drive small pendulum rotation.
node_conventions.cloth_* / banner: Cloth mesh; vertex attribute _pin (1 = pinned, 0 = free) for vertex-shader or cloth sim wind.
node_conventions.sign_*: Readable signboard (parent of the sign mesh, pivot at hinge); can also sway.
node_conventions.door_*: Door leaf with pivot at hinge for open/close.
node_conventions.ground_mud / ground_clutter / decals: Optional local mud apron, straw, stones and decals; engine may drop these if it has its own terrain.
